Name: More Traveling Cart Items
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[center][size=3][i]The Traveling Cart lady travels across the Ferngill Republic to share rare items.. you'd think she'd have a bit more than she does, right?
[/i]
Have you ever wanted to do a challenge where you completed a modded version of the community center without farming and could buy it all from the Traveling Cart?

Maybe you just want to be able to buy more items from mods from the Traveling Cart lady. 
[/size][/center][center][size=3][i]Now you can! [/i]This mod adds the new 1.6 crops as well as a variety of 1.6 items from vanilla to the Traveling Cart, and is compatible with SVE and Rigeside if you want a majority of the forage, fish, crops, and trees from those mods to be in the cart itself! It's also configurable so you can change the chance of something showing up![/size][/center]
If you have other ideas for other items to add to the shop, or other mods to add compatibility with, let me know and I'll look into it!

[u]Compatibility:[/u] Should work with all mods, but has built in compatibility with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]. You don't need to do anything to make them work, if you have the mod, it will automatically add the items to the cart!

To edit the chance one of these items will show up in the cart, please use the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/url]﻿
The configuration is fully translatable using the i18n format! Translators can feel free to upload their translations to Nexus with this mod as a dependancy (DO NOT upload any code, ONLY your translation file) for more info on how to do that see [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]This webpage[/url]﻿. You may also share the pastebin file so that I may upload it to the mod itself when it gets updates.
 
[b][u]Vanilla Items:[/u][/b]
[Spoiler]- Sea Jelly
- Cave Jelly
- River Jelly
- Goby
- Powdermelon
- Broccoli
- Summer Squash
- Carrot
- Powdermelon Seeds
- Broccoli Seeds
- Summer Squash Seeds
- Carrot Seeds
- Rasins
- Sonar Bobber
- Moss
- Deluxe Bait
- Mushroom Tree Seed
- Fiber Seeds
- Quality Bobber [/Spoiler]

[b][u]Stardew Valley Expanded Items:[/u][/b]
[Spoiler]- Most fish minus the legendary ones (wolf snapper and turret fish)
- All foragables found around the valley
- All crops (minus the golden carrot)
- All fruit trees and fruit tree fruit (minus the tree coin/money tree)
- All foods (minus the prismatic pop)
- Camel produce, tree seeds, tree produce, and a variety of miscellaneous items

Note: I did not include the elixirs but am considering adding a seperate toggable shop entry for them if there is enough want for it![/Spoiler]

[b][u]Ridgeside Village Items:[/u][/b]
[Spoiler]- Most fish minus the legendary ones (deep ridge angler, sockeye salmon, waterfall snakehead)
- All foragables found around ridgeside (minus the foxbloom)
- All fruit trees and fruit tree fruit
- All foods[/Spoiler]

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
